summary: Leader's Advantage Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company, consummated its $150,000,000 initial public offering of 15,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, each comprising one Class A ordinary share and one-half of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. The underwriters, Clear Street LLC and D. Boral Capital LLC, hold a 45-day option for 2,250,000 additional units. Concurrently the company executed an underwriting agreement, warrant agreement, investment management trust agreement and registration rights agreement with sponsor Leader's Advantage Company, LLC. Watch trust-account funding, over-allotment exercise and the 24-month de-SPAC deadline for redemption and deal risk.
